hypothesis: Bidding S5 on agent-priced leads instead of raw form fills shifts spend toward leads that book. S5 booking read: 19% of priced leads book, worth about $46 to $51 each; profit peaks at about $33 to $36 per priced lead. $36 is about $33.50 per form, about 17% below the current actual. Expected: about 25% fewer S5 leads (about 7 to 8 a day vs 9 to 10), higher booking share. Budget $270 to $225 is the backstop for Ben's mandatory $10K October cap (October was pacing about $10.5K).
